scope: Read-only tracking of a user-started GB10 quality16 run, which was cancelled before its first segment finished

sampled_clocks.thermal_and_power_slowdown_flags: Not Active at the sampled check

observations.GPU_memory: GB10 uses shared system/GPU memory; nvidia-smi reported dedicated memory as N/A

billing_estimate.window: Job start through confirmed rental deletion; upper bound rather than exact cancellation instant
billing_estimate.excludes: Pre-job setup, idle time, model downloads, transfer fees and any provider billing adjustments

closest_completed_run.hardware: RTX A6000 inferred from the saved active rental window; hardware was not stored directly on the historical job

older_matched_baselines.note: These two runs match one another; they differ from the current motion-transfer/quality16 job

hardware_context.interpretation: More memory capacity does not establish lower render latency; bandwidth specifications are not a measured speed multiplier

limitations: Cancelled sample: no completed GB10 runtime, accepted-output rate or visual-quality score
Higher resolution and more steps confound a direct GPU comparison
Pixel-times-steps is a workload proxy; attention, CFG, sampler, cache and offloading affect actual scaling
Early total estimates were provisional because the shorter second section never ran
The cancelled job was not resubmitted and the running workflow/settings were not changed by monitoring
